contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Return the substring from start inclusive to end exclusive, where indices count Unicode code points. Indices are already valid; do not clamp or swap them.
contract.domain: Strings are Unicode text of at most 128 code points. Lone surrogate code units are excluded. Start and end are integers with 0 <= start <= end <= the code-point length of text.

inputRoles.end: exclusive code-point end index, not a count

contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
